text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM. Moss's shared notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025: the gatehouse kiosk at their Eau Claire yard wasn't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers. It was patched the same evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I couldn't say when.

I also pointed out three things that could cause mistakes in the weekly notes:
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 in Moss's Central handoffs digest belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's note is about "Quarendon Freightways" (one R), a different company that isn't a customer, so I left it out.
- Moss's two other North digests mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers.

I looked only at files and channels Dana can see. Moss has six shared files and no posts in Dana's channels. I told Dana that if Moss has private notes, I can't see them.
